usedFor: Yellow.ai automates customer conversations, where “Create Or Update User” keeps profiles current and “New Template Created” flags new templates.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create Or Update User” in Yellow.ai
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message creates or refreshes the person's profile, so records stay current.

watchOut: “New Template Created” is polling, so it runs on a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
